concept.title: Geo-replication
concept.shortdesc: Geo-replication connects multiple geographically distributed Red Hat Quay deployments so that clients use them as a single registry. Standalone and Operator-based deployments support geo-replication.

conbody.p: With geo-replication, regions share one database and one Redis instance while each region keeps local object storage. Clients push and pull through a common entrypoint, typically a global load balancer, and blob data replicates asynchronously between storage backends.
